verdict.rationale: Asana markets in-product AI: AI Teammates that work inside workflows using Work Graph context and shared memory, Asana Dash billed as an 'AI Chief of Staff', and AI Studio. The only explicit claim of AI-generated reports and summaries from Asana data comes through the MCP server in external assistants such as Claude, not inside Asana itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI insights, summaries or suggestions drawn from the user's data; detail on what Dash actually surfaces; independent or hands-on corroboration.
